current_status.to: Replaced. On 2026-07-15 the Mercer County Commission voted unanimously (4-0, Guenthner absent) to lift the moratorium, contingent on final adoption and publication of the revised industrial zoning ordinances (including a new data center ordinance, second reading approved 3-1 the same day). The Bismarck Tribune reported the moratorium was lifted as the new ordinance came online on 2026-08-05. Residents presented a 475-signature petition that day asking for reinstatement; no reinstatement was found as of 2026-09-23.
current_status.reason: Central Nordak (2026-07-23), WDEA (2026-07-17) and Bismarck Tribune (2026-08-06) report the lift and the replacement ordinance.

outcome.from: Pending. Planning and Zoning continued data center ordinance work in March and April 2026; the March 3 meeting included second-reading public hearing on adding Data Center / Digital Asset Mining definitions and listing Data Center as a conditional use in the Industrial District; the third reading was set for March 18, 2026.
outcome.to: Data center zoning ordinance (with wind and solar ordinances) adopted on second reading 2026-07-15; moratorium lifted effective on the ordinance's publication (about 2026-08-05).
outcome.reason: The moratorium ended when a permanent ordinance took its place.

current_end_date_iso.reason: The lift took effect when the ordinance came online, reported by the Bismarck Tribune on Wednesday 2026-08-05.

evidence.supports: Commission voted 2026-07-15 to lift the moratorium, contingent on publication of the new ordinances.

decisions.notes: savrn and aigridwatch are right that it is no longer in force (savrn's 'June' is wrong: the vote was 2026-07-15, effective about 2026-08-05). Status is 'replaced', not rescinded: it was lifted because the permanent data center ordinance it was waiting for was adopted.
